name: 共起強度分析
description: 測定します the strength and naturalness of word 共起s using mutual information scores を識別するために AI生成の text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal word co-occurrence パターン and 共起 preferences
mechanism: 抽出します word pairs (bigrams, trigrams) and computes Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) and log-likelihood ratio scores を測定するために association strength. AI生成の text tends to favor high-frequency, 'safe' 共起s (e.g., 'significant impact', 'crucial role') while underusing creative, unusual, or idiomatic 共起s that are common in 人間の文章. The method builds a 共起 profile and compares it against reference corpora.
source: Church, K. W. & Hanks, P. (1990) - Word Association Norms, Mutual Information, and Lexicography, Computational Linguistics
algorithm: PMI Computation + Log-Likelihood Ratio + Collocation Profile Comparison
parameters: Window: 2-5 words, Metrics: PMI, t-score, log-likelihood, MI3, Min frequency: 2, Reference: BNC/COCA corpus
strengths:
• Captures subtle vocabulary combination パターン
• Well-established in corpus linguistics
• 検出します overuse of formulaic expressions
• Applicable にわたる text types
limitations:
• Requires large reference corpora for reliable PMI
• Domain-specific 共起s confound 分析
• Multi-word expressions need special handling
• Language-specific 共起 norms needed
